facts.fact: Ministry adviser Ines Ayadi says the national health identifier (EVAX identifier) is linked to the national ID card, social security number and school and university identifiers, and that medical files of about 100,000 people have been updated and linked to it, in public hospitals.

Mongi Slim hospital in La Marsa has piloted the national births-declaration platform since June 2026, declaring 202 births and assigning each a health identifier, with the platform meant to link to civil registry and social affairs systems and to wards and other health institutions.
